reason: I read labels and want the dose and an independent lab, and this names the lab and puts the batch report on the page, so I'd try one box at the $24.99 launch price. I would not pay $29.99 without testing it first.
objection: Two capsules every day is a lot to swallow, and $29.99 a month is real money on my budget. I also can't tell yet if the lab report is real until I open it and match the batch number.
would_change_my_mind: If the QR report didn't open or the batch number didn't match the box, I'd return it. If the regular price stayed at $29.99 with no launch deal, I'd probably pass.
